legend: Prominent koilocytic atypia (viral cytopathic change) in the upper levels of the epithelium close to the surface. The koilocytes have enlarged, wrinkled nuclei surrounded by a perinuclear halo.

Condyloma acuminatum with typical histopathologic features. These include The papillae with prominent central fibrovascular cores, hyperkeratosis, parakeratosis and koilocytosis. Koilocytes have enlarged, wrinkled nuclei surrounded by a perinuclear halo.
